name: Paicines
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A valley AVA in San Benito County, California, separated from Monterey County by the Gabilan Mountains. The San Benito River forms part of its boundary.
